name: glm53-sparse-v2
purpose: Long-context sparse qualification: the first 4096 IDs of long_qualification_text in crates/qwen-llm/src/glm5_next_metal/tests.rs (the qual-v1 passages plus three rounds of twelve more) through llama.cpp serial decode, plus a capture run of the indexer inputs and outputs at positions 4063, 4064, 4079 and 4095, where about 1016-1024 pools are visible and selection excludes about half of them.
token_source: tokens.txt in the location below; tests re-tokenize the text, take the first 4096 IDs and assert every oracle record's token matches

producer.device: Apple M4 Max 128 GB, Metal, all layers offloaded

serial.bin.run: logits only, n_batch = n_ubatch = 1, all 4096 positions

observations: The capture run's logits are byte-identical to the logits-only run at all 4096 positions.
The oracle wrapper accepts at most 4096 IDs (kMaxTokens); this run uses exactly that.
